headline: The Ibex 35 Falls 0.82% at Mid-Session, to 19,600 Points, Amid Doubts Over AI Slowdown
summary: Spain's Ibex 35 fell 0.82% at mid-session on Monday, standing near 19,600 points. Doubts over an AI slowdown weighed on the index.
why: The Ibex 35 is Spain's benchmark stock index, tracking the country's largest listed companies on the Madrid exchange.

impacts.name: Ibex 35
impacts.why: The benchmark index itself fell in mid-session trading.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The index fell amid doubts over an AI slowdown, according to the report.
